how_it_works.title: How you enter the $26,000 draw in four steps

steps.d: An initial deposit of $100 puts your first ticket in the draw. One entry opens per KYC-verified account, and the deposit funds your own trading account.
Every additional $100 you fund adds another ticket. Deposit $1,000 and you hold 10 tickets in the draw.
There's no cap. The more tickets you hold, the better your chance when the draw is made — every ticket counts equally.
When the countdown ends on 19 July 2026, one ticket is drawn at random. That holder wins the full $26,000.

items.t: How does the prize draw work?
items.d: It's a random prize draw. Every $100 you deposit during the campaign window earns one ticket, and a single ticket is drawn at random for the $26,000 prize. There's no skill scoring and no leaderboard ranking that decides the winner — every ticket has an equal chance.
Deposit. $100 = 1 ticket, $500 = 5 tickets, $1,000 = 10 tickets, and so on. There's no upper limit, so the more you deposit, the more tickets you hold and the better your odds in the draw.

It funds your own trading account and remains yours. The deposit is what earns your tickets — it is not a separate entry fee, and you can trade with it under the platform's normal conditions. Trading carries risk of loss; trade within your means.

items.t: When and how is the winner drawn?
items.d: Entries lock at 23:59 GST on 19 July 2026. One ticket is then drawn at random and the winner is announced on 20 July 2026 on the Warren Bowie & Smith website, by email, and across our social channels.
